business_problem: Retool wanted to lower the barrier for businesses to build AI-powered internal applications because many high-value operational processes were still trapped in manual or spreadsheet-based workflows.
solution_summary: Retool integrated GPT-4 into Retool AI so teams can assemble AI-powered business applications using prebuilt building blocks instead of starting from scratch. Within the visual canvas, common model actions such as text generation and image description become configurable components that builders can place inside workflow apps, while Retool keeps the surrounding environment focused on data access, testing, deployment, and governance. A typical flow starts with operational data or a support question entering a Retool app, GPT-4 handling the natural-language or content-generation step, and the result being routed back into the application's interface so employees or customers can act on it. Retool highlighted support chatbots, inventory management, and tailored product experiences as early examples of this pattern. That architecture turns AI from an isolated experiment into a repeatable capability inside the same low-code system businesses already use for internal software.
